chunks: From him, from Abi Ja'far, from Musa ibn al-Qasim, from 'Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man and a woman who apply dye and perform salat (prayer) while they are covered with henna and wasmah. He said: If the mouth and the nostril are left exposed, then there is no harm. The first report is to be understood as indicating karahah, while these reports are to be understood as indicating permissibility.

key_terms.الْكَرَاهِيَةِ: dislikedness; legal reprehensibility short of prohibition

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while wearing henna or wasmah dye?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on performing salat (prayer) while henna and wasmah dye are on the body. It states that there is no problem so long as the mouth and nostril remain exposed, and it reconciles earlier reports by interpreting one as indicating karahah and others as indicating permissibility.
